description: This Java class defines a scheduled task that checks internet connectivity by attempting to connect to a specified URL. If the connection fails, it notifies users with the 'System Developer' role via alerts.

classes.name: CheckInternetConnectivityTask
classes.description: A task that checks internet connectivity by attempting to connect to a URL and sends alerts to users with the 'System Developer' role if the connection fails.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the connectivity check by attempting to connect to a predefined URL and sending alerts if an IOException occurs.
